general.question: What is AI2ART?
general.answer: AI2ART is an AI image generation and photo remix platform for turning text prompts and uploaded images into polished visuals. The service is powered by GPT Image 2 and is independent from the underlying model provider.

commercial.question: Can I use the images for commercial purposes?
commercial.answer: Yes. Images generated with eligible paid plans include a commercial license, allowing you to use them in marketing, social media, and commercial projects subject to our terms.

aiModels.question: Which AI models do you use?
aiModels.answer: AI2ART currently uses GPT Image 2 for image generation and remix workflows. AI2ART is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the model provider.

credits.question: How does the credit system work?
credits.answer: You use credits to generate or remix images. You can purchase credit packs or subscribe to a monthly plan to receive a steady supply of credits at a discount.

refund.question: Do you offer refunds?
refund.answer: We offer a satisfaction guarantee. If an image generation fails due to a system error, we will refund the credits. For subscription payments, please contact our support team within 7 days if you're not satisfied.

support.question: How can I get support?
support.answer: Our dedicated support team is available 24/7. You can reach us via the contact form on our website or by emailing support@ai2art.net.
